cards.name: CouchDB (notes sync)
cards.hint: Sync server for Obsidian Self-hosted LiveSync. Reached via :443/couchdb. Logs: docker compose logs couchdb

cards.name: LiveSync Bridge
cards.hint: Headless CouchDB <-> data/memory-vault/notes/ mirror so the AI reads Obsidian notes. Health via container healthcheck. Logs: docker compose logs livesync-bridge
cards.notes: Portless headless worker: no HTTP check on purpose — grid reads container health via ops-api (routes_hub).
